data.name: Guard_Title
data.value: Change the randomization of a game in progress?

data.name: Guard_Message
data.value:
The seed or the options differ from the ROM you are playing. Building now creates a different game: the Pokémon you already have keep their species, but their base stats, abilities and learnsets change, and so do wild Pokémon and trainers.
If you only wanted to tweak some Pokémon, cancel and put back the seed. The current version stays in History either way, so you can go back.

data.name: History_Hint
data.value: A version is saved every time you build the ROM, before restoring or importing, and before writing the save editor's changes. ROMs are not copied: the same version rebuilds the same ROM. Each version also keeps a copy of your save from that moment.

data.name: History_Empty
data.value: No versions yet. One is saved the next time you build the ROM, or save one now.

data.name: History_SaveMessage
data.value: Saves the project as it is now (and a copy of your save), to come back to it later. Versions saved by hand are never deleted automatically.

data.name: History_RestoreMessage
data.value: The project goes back to the version of {0} ({1}): seed, randomizer options and manual changes. The current state is saved in History first.

data.name: History_RestoreRebuild
data.value: Build the ROM now and adapt my current save to it (keeps your progress)

data.name: History_RestoreSave
data.value: Also put back the save as it was on {0} (progress made since then is lost; the current save is backed up)

data.name: History_RestoreSaveUnavailable
data.value: This version has no copy of the save

data.name: History_SaveRestored
data.value: Save put back (backup of the replaced one: {0}).

data.name: History_DeleteMessage
data.value: The version of {0} ({1}) and its copy of the save will be deleted.
